notes.title: Update 1.0.5-Fixed a reverse time crash
notes.content:
Through the implementation of a new feature(not yet announced or ready for public), I broke the reverse system.  I have since fixed the reverse time system.

-Since I was fixing stuff Guy will no longer face upward each time you reverse fully.

notes.title: Several Small updates
notes.content:
I updated a few small things:
[list]
[*] I fixed a few typos in dialogs found by a player
[*] I believe I fixed the bug where shep in running one direction, but is sprite is showing a different direction(even though it looks funny)
 
I may have fixed a few issues with reversing time and skeletons including:
[*] The skeleton would at times start running the wrong way(very rare)
[*] I believe I fixed when you reverse the skeleton doesn't see players anymore...this is SUPER rare so hard to test.
[*] Right after a reverse time, the skeleton would walk back to start, but the " red vision" sprite would show the wrong way.
[/list]

notes.title: Unforgettable Voyage has released!
notes.content:
[b]Unforgettable Voyage has been released![/b]  

After nearly 2 years of solo development I am happy to have the full release of Unforgettable Voyage ready for you. You can now complete your journey with Guy, Shep, and Mole as they try to solve puzzles, get rich, and try to find their Cap'n.

[b]Things to look forward to in the full release:[/b]
[list]
[*] Harness Mole and his hook hands that allows him to get to places Guy and Shep can not.
[*] A total of 48 islands full of puzzles, including more challenging egg puzzles, lots of coins, and treasure chests.
[*] Three new unlockable abilities, one new ability for each character.
[*] Go back to those islands with items you couldn't collect earlier and get them with your new skills.
[*] More boss fights!
[*] Find the golden egg?
[*] Main Story Play Time: 4-6 hours playtime
[*] 100% Collectables: 8-10 hours playtime
[/list]

If you pick it up during this release sale you will [u][b]save 20%[/b][/u].
